It is still a hello-world skeleton; the README honestly documents go install only.
External gates, recorded for the final report:
(a) Release secrets (HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN, MACOS_*) and the first v0.1.0 release are blocked because 1Password is signed out.
(b) The social-preview upload needs the user (docs/assets/social-preview.jpg).
(c) cc-notes FuseKit provisioning in cc-sync failed ("source authority fleet is not configured"); refs and the reconcile workflow work.
(d) cc-notes papercut 336a178 in cc-sync: a repo-bootstrap verify false positive on the cc-skills precommit comment tokens.
